messages.content: The Friday morning museum entries are available, so switch to the Thursday flight. Recheck that flight and the L'Enfant Plaza hotel, then make sure the whole schedule works before you book.

Both are still available. American departs O'Hare Thursday, October 10 at 7:20 p.m. and arrives DCA at 10:13 p.m.; the Monday return leaves DCA at 6:15 p.m. and reaches O'Hare at 7:36 p.m. The three round-trip tickets total $1,143. The Hilton Washington DC National Mall The Wharf at L'Enfant Plaza has one room with two queen beds for four nights at $1,089.44 including tax.
Walk me through the late arrival and Monday. I don't want to buy this and find out the desk closes or that the return is too tight.

The hotel front desk operates 24 hours. DCA to the hotel is about 15-25 minutes by taxi or rideshare at that hour, so arrival should be around 10:45-11:15 p.m. I can add the flight details and a late-arrival note to protect the room. Checkout Monday is 11:00 a.m.; the hotel will hold your bags. Leaving the hotel by 4:15 p.m. gives you roughly two hours at DCA before the 6:15 p.m. departure.
And the room definitely holds Marcus, Daniel, and Owen? What is the cancellation cutoff?

Yes. The reservation is for three guests in one non-smoking room with two queen beds. The refundable rate can be canceled without penalty through 6:00 p.m. Wednesday, October 9; after that, the first night's room and tax are charged.
All right. Buy the three tickets and reserve that room. Add the late check-in note.

Before I submit: the combined flight-and-hotel total is $2,232.44. The Thursday arrival supports the Friday morning museum entry, and the Monday timing works with bag storage and the evening flight. Shall I complete both at that total?

Confirmed. American record locator: D8L4QH, $1,143 for all three passengers. Hilton confirmation: HWM-481725, $1,089.44 including tax, Thursday, October 10 through Monday, October 14, in one two-queen room for three guests. The late-arrival note includes the 10:13 p.m. DCA landing. Hotel cancellation is penalty-free until 6:00 p.m. Wednesday, October 9. Total booked: $2,232.44. Plan on a taxi or rideshare to the hotel Thursday and leave the hotel by 4:15 p.m. Monday for the 6:15 p.m. return.
